description: Shows one trip from a find_trips answer step by step, door to door: leaving home, the train or bus to the airport, the airport wait, the flight, the transfer into the city and arrival, then the way back, with local times. Also gives the booking link and a calendar file (.ics) the user can add. Pass a trip id from the find_trips answer ("Trip ids, row by row", or a row's `id`); "the best one" is the find_trips answer's top pick. Use it when the user picks a trip or asks how the journey works. Ids are kept for 72 hours. The widget shows every leg, so reply in at most 4 sentences with no table: the summary line, the times that matter (leaving home, the flight, arriving) and the booking link. Don't look up flights, airports or transit elsewhere: our times come from the fare, and a layover is a connection that is part of the trip.

trip_id.description: A trip id from the find_trips answer, e.g. "t_k3m9q2xa".
